subject: ready-for-life

location.unitTitle: Kitchen Care and Basic Food Safety

instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain kitchen reset in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of handwashing.
Apply cross-contamination basics in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving safe tool identification; correct it and explain why.
Connect kitchen reset with storage and cleanup. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Use the frozen kitchen lessons and safely complete a guardian-approved food-preparation loop.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Kitchen Care and Basic Food Safety?
